value.rationale: Separate gradient and curl filters were introduced to avoid shared-spectrum and smoothing difficulties. The exact 3/5 divisibility family supplies concrete signal-processing cases where no polynomial in the combined Hodge operator can perfectly separate the two spaces, while the unique optimal diffusion balance has an abrupt six/seven-cell geometry threshold and n^-2 size penalty. Both address natural questions about two-dimensional cyclic meshes rather than arbitrary fitted parameters.
